# Astro Component Starter

> Build fast, customizable Astro sites with a modern component starter that is easy to edit and maintain.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Fast, visually editable components for Astro and CloudCannon.
- [Why](/why/): Why this starter was built and how it helps teams ship static sites.
- [Blog](/blog/): Articles on development, design, and the component library.

## Blog

- [A Better Starting Point for Modern Websites](/blog/2025-10-15-why-we-built-our-component-starter/): Predictable structure, honest docs, and a component set you can actually ship.
- [Accessibility Shouldn't Be an Afterthought](/blog/2025-12-10-accessibility-by-default/): Semantic structure, focusable controls, and inclusive defaults.
